_comment: helm-env-schema-parity allowlist (merged_bug_161 class close): every entry is a config-schema field DELIBERATELY not rendered as a chart env, with the why. The check fails when a schema field is neither rendered nor listed here — a knob added in Rust but forgotten in the chart (the RIO_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS / RIO_LOG_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS class) cannot ship silently again. rio-builder has no chart Deployment (builder env comes from the controller's SpawnIntent Job templates) and is out of scope.
